title: Level-Change Adjustment Credit on an Assisted Living Respite Stay
content:
When a nurse assessment during an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement has placed the guest in another care level and the stay record already shows the new stay type, its care points and its level effective date, the nights moved to the new level are re-leveled, and the level-change credit is posted against the segment being re-leveled, which is the stay's latest nightly charge segment.

## What the credit does

- It is a level-change adjustment credit on the stay account: the re-leveled nights of the latest nightly charge segment are credited back against that segment.
- It references the segment credited and states the nights credited.
- It lowers the stay balance by the credit amount; the guest sees the credit on the stay statement and a lower balance owed.

## Situation of use

| On the stay record | Position |
|---|---|
| A nurse assessment during an Assisted Living Respite Stay placed the guest in another care level | The nights moved to the new level are re-leveled |
| The record shows the new stay type, its care points and its level effective date | The level-change credit is posted against the segment being re-leveled |
| The segment being re-leveled | The stay's latest nightly charge segment |

## How it is invoked

The posting is made with the agent-side tool `credit_relevel_nights_cb1c5023`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; one call records one credit entry, dated today.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `respite_stay_id` | Reference number of the respite or trial stay whose account is credited, as returned by the stay lookup | Identifier |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the nightly charge segment entry being credited, as returned by the stay ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `credited_nights` | Number of nights credited back | Whole number of nights |
| `credit_amount` | Amount of the credit in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new credit entry reference number, the stay reference number, the nights credited, the credit amount in USD with 2 decimal places and the resulting stay balance. A returned entry reference number means the credit was posted.

## Hypothetical receipt

A call for a hypothetical stay with 9 nights and 2,151.00 returns a sentence of the form: level-change adjustment credit (entry reference) posted on stay (stay reference): 9 nights, 2151.00 USD; stay balance now (new balance) USD.
